basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. I've been navigating the digital streets of Reddit for a decade, diving deep into discussions about technology, society, and mental health. Outside of Reddit, you'll find me hiking the trails of the Texas Hill Country or gaming with friends online. I'm passionate about debunking myths in popular science and often engage in debates on various platforms. My typical online hours are in the evenings and late nights after work. Currently, I'm single and focusing on personal growth and career advancement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have over 12 years of experience in software development. My interest in mental health stems from personal experiences and a strong desire to understand human psychology. I frequently read academic journals and participate in online courses related to psychology and social sciences.
